<Heading

  children={"Retrieve a run"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/run/{id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns one run of the caller's organization with its results and their traces, or, with `include_results=false`, with its result counts instead (much lighter for large runs). A cloud run's token may read the runs of its own run tree. For a campaign run's progress and outcome, `GET /run/{id}/summary` and `GET /run/{id}/report` are lighter and computed for you.
